consent.title: Notice on the Collection, Processing and Use of Personal Data
consent.body_html:
In accordance with Article 8 of Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act (the "PDPA"), before collecting your personal data this system informs you of the following. Please read carefully:

1. Data Collector

Yu-Cheng Chang (張育丞), owner of this system and course instructor.

2. Purpose of Collection

Education or training administration (code 109) and student data management (code 158): allowing students to view their grades, rankings, class grade distribution and course alerts for the courses they take, and to complete course surveys.

3. Categories of Personal Data

Identifying data (student ID, name); learning records (coursework, attendance, number of absences, quizzes, midterm exam, final exam, bonus points and total grade); survey responses; system login records (login time, IP address).

4. Period, Region, Recipients and Method of Use

  • Period: from the course period until grades are finalized, and until the retention period set by school regulations expires.
  • Region: where this system's servers are located (Cloudflare cloud services) and within the Republic of China (Taiwan).
  • Recipients: you and the course instructor. Class rankings and grade distributions are shown only as statistics and never display other students' names or student IDs.
  • Method: viewed, compiled and displayed electronically.

5. Your Rights (PDPA Article 3)

You may request from the course instructor to: inquire about or review your data, obtain a copy, supplement or correct it, stop its collection, processing or use, and have it deleted.

6. Consequences of Not Providing Data

Whether to agree is entirely your choice. If you do not agree, you will not be able to view your grades online through this system, but this will not affect how you are graded, and you may still check your grades with the course instructor in person.

7. Security Measures

This system protects your data with encrypted connections (HTTPS), Cloudflare human verification, captcha, automatic logout when idle, and logout when the browser is closed. Please do not share your login details with others, and log out when you are done.

If there is any discrepancy between this translation and the Chinese version of this notice, the Traditional Chinese version shall prevail.

ct.help_html:
Class Toolbox guide

Free, no login. Rosters, points, seating charts and whiteboards are stored only in this browser on this computer and never uploaded.

1. Build a class roster

  • Download template: each worksheet is one class (sheet name = class name). Fill in seat no., ID and name, then click "Import Excel".
  • Import from link: share a Google Sheet or Excel Online file (OneDrive / SharePoint) as "Anyone with the link can view" and paste the link.
  • Paste list: one name per line; line 1 becomes No. 1. You can also paste three columns from Excel.
  • Class size only: enter how many students to create No. 1–N.
  • Edit the table directly; "Export roster" downloads an Excel file with points.

2. Draw names

  • 15 styles, up to 5 people at a time; the animation runs once per person.
  • Space starts/stops, ↑ adds a point, ↓ deducts one.
  • Tick absent students under "Absent today" to leave them out of draws and groups.

3. Seats

  • Seating chart: set rows and seats per row, arrange by seat no., randomly or by dragging, then save.
  • Import seating chart: the worksheet looks like the room. Row 1 is the front (next to the board); each cell holds a seat no., ID or name; empty cells are empty seats. Put it in the roster file (sheet named "座位表" / "Seats" or "Class A Seats") or import it on its own.
  • Seat draw: random patterns or coordinates.

4. Games

Dice, coins, moon blocks and rock-paper-scissors, with a spotlight mode for projecting.

5. Random groups

  • Enter the number of groups or group size and click "Make groups"; each group gets a random leader.
  • "Edit group" lets you change the leader, give each member a job and set contribution shares (total 100%, or "Split evenly").
  • "Download" saves a CSV.

6. Whiteboard

  • Pen, pencil, brush, watercolor, highlighter, laser pointer, eraser, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse and text, with custom and pinned colors and a width slider; hold Shift for squares, circles and 45° lines.
  • Shapes: triangles, squares, circles, stars, hearts, polygons…, optionally filled. Text has its own size and font.
  • Formula: type LaTeX with live preview; double-click a formula to edit it.
  • Automatic answers and charts: write an expression or equation (as a formula or text, e.g. 2x+3=7, y=x^2) and the answer appears beside it with a chart below; turn them off with "Answer" and "Chart" in the toolbar.
  • Image: pick a file or paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V.
  • "Select" moves items, the corner handle resizes, Delete removes; Ctrl+Z undoes.
  • Backgrounds (grid, lined, chalkboard), several pages, PNG download and full screen.
  • Side tools: calculator, graphs (up to 3 functions, e.g. sin(x)) and random questions, all of which can be put on the board.

Circuits

The Circuits tab is a separate circuit editor with a category menu and digital logic tools (K-map, truth table, complements, BCD, Gray code, base conversion). Symbols include: resistors, capacitors, inductors, sources, switches, diodes, transistors, op-amps, motors, transformers, meters and logic gates. Connect them with the Wire tool; selected symbols can be rotated 90°, recolored and resized.

7. Timer

  • Countdown: 1, 3, 5, 10 minutes or your own time; it ticks in the last 10 seconds and rings at the end.
  • Stopwatch with laps.
  • Clock with the current time and date.
  • All three go full screen; a small timer shows at the top right on other tabs.

8. Moving computers

Data stays on this computer. Download a backup from the Roster tab and restore it on the new computer.

Enjoying Class Toolbox?Give it a Star on GitHub to show your support! Questions or fresh ideas are always welcome there too.

In a private window, everything is lost when you close the tab.
